exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital's received units; other entities do not affect this hospital's receipts.

exclusions.name: Elena Cruz's actions
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection or shipping; her actions do not change the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Friday collection
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is open Friday 9-5, but any units collected Friday would not be shipped before Friday noon (next shipment is Tuesday/Thursday), so they cannot be received by the deadline.

uncertainties.meaning: The exact number of units collected each day is unknown; only the average rate of 12 units per hour is given, but actual collection may vary.
Whether the centre's stock after Monday's collection is sufficient to dispatch 150 units on Tuesday is unknown because Monday's collection total is uncertain.
Whether the centre's stock after collections Monday through Thursday is sufficient to dispatch 150 units on Thursday is unknown because collection totals are uncertain.

Whether the Thursday shipment arrives before Friday noon is unknown because the dispatch time is 4:00 PM Thursday and transit takes 3 hours, arriving at 7:00 PM Thursday, which is before Friday noon, so this is actually certain. But the uncertainty about stock sufficiency may affect whether the shipment occurs.
